cs.t: > Is it that I always use Samsung or SanDisk SD cards with the Pi? Oddly enough, Samsung, SanDisk, and Sony are the three brands I've had die on me.  I had a GoPro eat two Sony cards in less than a year, I switched to SanDisk Endurance and it's been plugging along for about 2 years now.  I've had one Samsung and a couple SanDisk SD cards die in Raspberry Pi's.  I'm currently using MicroCenter, AData and one other lower tier brand that have held up much better than the name brands.
